responsibility: Defines the owning-reference API used in rustc, including `OwningRef`, `OwningRefMut`, owner-erasure support, trait impls, conversions, and standard-library integrations that let a stable owner be carried together with references into its contents.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is a large self-contained API for owner-coupled references and handles, including mutable variants, owner erasure, trait impls, and many std-type integrations; it is neither a graph/snapshot algorithm module nor a thin re-export facade like `sso/mod.rs`.
